<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"><diagram name="GitOps gate" id="gitops-gate"><mxGraphModel dx="900" dy="380" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="900" pageHeight="380" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/><mxCell id="title" value="GitOps gate" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1A1A2E;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="14" width="860" height="24" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="subtitle" value="a restart only runs when ownership is clear and the window is open" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontSize=12;fontColor=#666666;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="860" height="16" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="n" value="Restart needed
dependency is stale" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3e8fd;strokeColor=#7209b7;fontColor=#1a1a2e;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="350" y="78" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="q" value="Owner known
& sync window open?" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff0e6;strokeColor=#f97316;fontColor=#1a1a2e;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="320" y="186" width="260" height="72" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="blocked" value="Blocked
wait & re-check later" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fce8e6;strokeColor=#ea4335;fontColor=#1a1a2e;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="130" y="300" width="220" height="62" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="run" value="Controlled restart
rollout executes" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f4ea;strokeColor=#34a853;fontColor=#1a1a2e;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="550" y="300" width="220" height="62" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e0" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#8a8f99;fontColor=#8a8f99;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="n" target="q"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="no" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#ea4335;fontColor=#ea4335;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="q" target="blocked"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="yes" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#34a853;fontColor=#34a853;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="q" target="run"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: a restart only runs when ownership is clear and the window is open
